series_annotator.narrative: The series exhibits mixed trend direction with strong trend and moderate seasonality. High concept drift and unstable rankings suggest using a weighted approach with dynamic error adaptation, avoiding ridge stacking due to high regularization needs.

reasoning.ade_dynamic_error_beta0.5_trim0.8: series_profile.model_landscape.concept_drift=true → concept drift present; ADE dynamic error weighting adapts to changing model performance over time
reasoning.inverse_rmse_weights_k4_sh0.35: series_profile.combination_recommendation.regularization=high AND recommended_knobs.shrinkage=0.35 → high regularization requires shrinkage to prevent overfitting with few windows
reasoning.best_per_horizon_by_validation: series_profile.model_landscape.horizon_homogeneous=false → different models dominate at different horizons; per-horizon selection captures this structure
